sections.title: Services and *add-ons*
sections.intro: There is no need to choose a style in advance. Your therapist will discuss your goals and suggest the right blend.

items.name: Chair massage
items.desc: 15 or 30 minute sessions, fully clothed, in a specially designed chair.

items.name: Aromatherapy
items.desc: Five lotions made with pure essential oils: Bliss, Calming, Energy, Renewal and Serenity.

items.name: Silicone cupping
items.desc: A traditional treatment that can help resolve chronic muscle tightness and pain faster than massage alone.

items.name: CBD massage
items.desc: CBD massage oil to help reduce inflammation and soothe muscles and joints.

sections.footnote: Standard prices as listed on the current site. Be sure to ask about promotional rates.

sections.title: The right style for *what you need*

items.title: Swedish massage
items.text: Smooth, gliding strokes with firm but gentle pressure to promote relaxation and ease muscle tension.

items.title: Deep tissue massage
items.text: Relieves severe tension in the muscles and connective tissue below the surface.

items.title: Trigger point therapy
items.text: Releases tension around specific points. Great for cramped and overused muscles.

items.title: Chair massage
items.text: Performed with your clothes on. Excellent for relaxation.

items.title: Reiki
items.text: A hands-on technique intended to bring a state of balance.

sections.title: A nurse's knowledge, *a therapist's hands*
body: Nancy has been a practicing health care professional for over thirty years as a Registered Nurse. She is a graduate of the Connecticut Center for Massage Therapy, a Licensed Massage Therapist, and a Certified Member of the Associated Bodywork & Massage Professionals.
Her bodywork includes Swedish massage, deep-tissue massage, trigger-point massage, sports massage, silicone cupping, aromatherapy and CBD massage.

items.text: I very much enjoyed my massage, very relaxing, and Nancy did a great job. I will definitely be back and will tell all my friends.
